topic.title: Why the rich never leave $20,000 of cash sitting at almost 0% for 10 years

title: Your $20,000 savings: what the rich do with it 🤫
description:
Is your emergency cash sleeping at almost 0%? The rich don't let it.
Same $20,000, same 10 years: an assumed 0.4% vs an assumed 4% a year, computed. No product named, rates are assumptions. Speak to a licensed financial adviser in your country before making financial decisions.
Illustrative only. Not financial advice.

lines.text: Rich people never let their cash sleep.
Wait, what? My $20,000 is safe in the bank. It pays about 0.4%.
Safe, and asleep. In 10 years, it grows to just $20,815.
Mine sits in an account paying an assumed 4%. Still cash. It just works.
Same $20,000. Same 10 years. That's $8,790 more, for doing nothing.
I left that on the table? For 10 years?
Is your cash asleep? Because rich people...
